title: Modeling and simulating depositional sequences using latent Gaussian random fields

claimEvidence.support: Direct transformed latent Gaussian thickness-field definition

claimEvidence.locator: Introduction and Section 3.1, Equation (1), otherwise branch

exclusionEvidence.finding: The latent fields W_j are assumed independent because they represent independent depositional processes; within-layer spatial covariance must not be misrepresented as a cross-layer correlation matrix.

limitations: The full-text PDF is not stored in the repository.
This evidence does not validate a cross-layer covariance implementation.
This evidence does not establish universal covariance coefficients or ranges.
